description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the class 'DuePenFeeIntPriInAdvancePriPenFeeIntLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor'. It tests different scenarios of loan repayment processing, including in-advance payments, on-time payments, late payments, and partial payments, for various components like principal, interest, fees, and penalties, with specific focus on edge cases and the handling of charges. The tests utilize Mockito to mock dependencies and verify that components are paid appropriately under different conditions.
